scope: Static official source; not matched to the actual macOS build and not itself a host denial observation.

sources.fact: The loader asks separate sandbox operations for executable mmap, data open and metadata stat.

sources.name: Loader.cpp
sources.fact: The mmap error branch distinguishes a sandbox mapping refusal only after actual mmap EPERM and a sandbox check. It is not proof that this branch produced the observed libignition stack.

sources.name: common.sb
sources.fact: The public policy supports version 1/3 build branches; this does not establish the exact shipped OS profile semantics.
